description:
COLORFUL LIGHT-UP RIDING - Seven-color LED deck lighting creates a bright, eye-catching glow for added fun and visibility. The blue wave graphics give this kids’ scooter an energetic look that stands out during every ride.

BUILT-IN SPEAKER - The integrated speaker lets young riders enjoy music while cruising. Combined with colorful lighting effects, it creates an entertaining riding experience for neighborhood trips and outdoor play.

SMART HANDLEBAR CONTROLS - The easy-to-read digital display shows speed and battery information at a glance. Three selectable speed modes and a convenient thumb throttle allow riders to control the scooter directly from the handlebar.

SOLID PUNCTURE-RESISTANT TIRES - Durable solid tires eliminate the need for inflation and help reduce maintenance. The sturdy front fork and stable deck provide dependable support across smooth pavement and other suitable riding surfaces.

DESIGNED FOR RIDERS AGES 8+ - Recommended for children ages eight and older, with a maximum supported load of approximately 110 kg/242 lb. Riders should always wear a helmet and suitable protective equipment and ride under adult supervision.
